# S4.14a — extension supply-chain trust (C1) + third-party install

- **Ticket:** `docs/tickets/076_S4.14a__supply-chain-trust-and-third-party-install.md`
- **Branch:** `svitali/harnessharness-s4.14a` (stacked on `svitali/harnessharness-s4.13` @ `ba160e3`)
- **Requirement:** R-2.8.5 (C1), R-2.8.7 (C1 Stage-4), R-2.12.2¹
- **Closes:** AC-R-2.8.5-{4,6,7,8,9} · AC-R-2.8.7-{8,10,12,13} · R-2.12.2¹ foreign/placement legs
- **Mode:** Stage 4, `offline-only`; no explicit gate.

## Build log

- **hh-registry — lifecycle** (`crates/hh-registry/src/extension/lifecycle.rs`):
  `TrustRootPolicy` gates at `discover`/`resolve` (source allowlists,
  `required_predicates` verified against attestation coverage,
  `require_signature_for` → `Admission::Quarantined`, `StalePin` on policy
  supersession/stale signer); `pin` lifts to a definition pin; `review()`
  renders the advisory plan (extension id, install plan, requested env keys,
  surface delta, attestation status, text hygiene); `update_assessment`
  reports widening (new hook paths) + named `LabelRegression`s — a dropped
  `trust.surface_pin` is `{field: "trust.surface_pin", now: "unpinned"}`;
  `approve_seal_diff`, update/supersession; `model_install` procedure
  (`install_requested`/`install_completed` payloads, attenuated+tainted
  result, `AuthorityWidening`); `propagate_revocation` — surfaces dropped,
  grants → deny, in-flight effects → `unknown`, `depends_on_revoked`
  annotations; `check_surface` + `DriftPolicy{notify,pause_surface,
  terminate}` emitting `security.extension.drift`.
- **hh-registry — foreign plugins** (`extension/foreign_plugin.rs`): the
  `ForeignPluginFormat` closed sum (`claude`/`gemini`/`codex`); imports land
  quarantined with a named `LossReport`; Gemini `trust` members are claims,
  never grants; export + re-import round trip declares its losses.
- **hh-monitor** (`src/approval.rs`): `ApproverGrant` record +
  `grant_approver`/`revoke_approver` (principal bootstrap; `covers_grant`
  never widens; grantor-or-principal revoke; `IllegitimateGrant` typed);
  respond-path gate — `EndorserRef::ApproverGrant` legitimates only under a
  live covering grant (ADR-0306 D1; OQ-177 resolved as a ledgered record);
  `security.permission.grant_{issued,revoked}` fold in
  `ApprovalState::project`; `ReviewerBinding` + `check_auto_review_binding`
  (typed per-clause refusal), `auto_review_failure_denies` (> reversible),
  `reviewed_payload` for `security.permission.reviewed` (class + hosted
  lowering registered in `hh-ledger/src/classes.rs`).
- **hh-acp** (`src/permission.rs`, `src/serve.rs`): `params._hh` preserves
  `permissionId`/`effectId`/`effectiveRiskClass`/`reasonCode` verbatim;
  `modify`/`escalate`/`abort_run`/`max_uses`/`deadline` lower as named
  `hh-edge-loss/1` losses; `inbound_losses` on `PermissionRequest`; outcome
  parse deny-by-default.
- **hh-eval** (`src/catalogue.rs`): `approval_rate`, `denial_rate`,
  `approvals_per_kilo_effect`, `median_decision_latency_ms` (bootstrap —
  `ms` is heavy-tailed, CLT forbidden per ADR-0158), `lease_hit_ratio`,
  `auto_review_fn_rate` (judge-oracle) — all `permission_surface`-gated so
  hosted-without-capability renders `n/a{class}`.
- **hh-lab** (`src/exemplars.rs`): `lab/extension-trust-v1` —
  `trust{external,sealed} × isolation{confined,unconfined}` full-factorial,
  `MatchSpec ∋ approvals.requested`, Π-denial primaries;
  `lab/approval-mode-v1` — `approval_mode × reviewer × budget`,
  `MatchSpec ∋ approvals.requested`, `auto_review_fn_rate`/
  `median_decision_latency_ms` primaries, calibration-debt conditioning.
- **hh-varhost** (`src/session.rs`, `src/lib.rs`): `SpawnSpec.placement` +
  `helper_extra_args`; `container` forces the helper `container` lane;
  `remote` never spawns (`attach` over a caller transport);
  `in_process`/`component_model`/`host_unconfined` refuse typed
  (`PlacementRefused`); `VariantSession::isolation()` reports the real lane,
  never a stronger claim.
- **hh-identity** (`src/supersede.rs`): supersession/revocation edges,
  stale-by-dependency and `depends_on_revoked` propagation for the registry
  store.
- **hh-embed** (`src/extension_ops.rs` + dispatch): `lab.extension.*` and
  `lab.permission.{grant,revoke}_approver` boundary ops; schema regen
  (`schema/hh-embed-1.schema.json`,
  `crates/hh-embed-client-generated/src/generated.rs` — check-drift clean).
- **Tests:** `crates/hh-registry/tests/s4_14a.rs` (16), `crates/hh-monitor/
  tests/s4_14a.rs` (9), `crates/hh-acp/tests/s4_14a.rs` (4).
- **ADR-0306** records the five rulings: ledgered `ApproverGrant`
  (OQ-177), caller-asserted auto_review binding (CC1), `_hh` preservation +
  named losses, surface-pin drop as named regression, foreign trust members
  as claims.

## Notes / deviations

- **`WakeupPolicy::from_json` member-defaults fix**
  (`crates/hh-ledger/src/wakeup.rs`): missing policy members now
  take the documented defaults while unknown spellings still
  refuse. The pre-existing strict decode broke
  `subscribe{policy:{delivery_mode}}` at base —
  `hh-embed`/`tests/conformance.rs::s4_13_wakeup_subscribe_and_
  idempotent_occurrence` red on the untouched base, green after.
  Deterministic compatibility fix; fully-spelled policies decode
  identically.
- **Helper-binary contamination (environmental, recorded).** An
  early `cargo test --workspace` attempt overlapped a
  `check-removability.sh` leg that builds `hh-helper`
  `--no-default-features`; the shared `target/debug/hh-helper` was
  left tier-0 and eight helper-live legs reported honest
  `preserve_until requires tier-c1` refusals. The refusal was the
  *correct* tier-0 behaviour — not a product defect. Serialized the
  runs, `cargo build -p hh-helper` restored the default binary, and
  the workspace rerun above is clean end-to-end.
- **OQ-177 interim resolved** — `ApproverGrant` conferral is a
  ledgered record (`security.permission.grant_{issued,revoked}`),
  never a name; see ADR-0306 D1.
- **Deferrals** — dated progress on DF-S1.23-2 (the
  `security.extension.*` emitters now emit from the real lifecycle
  paths; `DeclaredSource` scanners, `LegCrossing`/L3 runtime checks
  and `TextHygieneReport` consumers remain). No new rows opened.
